title: Quantitative Chemistry: Mass, Moles and Concentrations

flashcard_questions.q: The substances that react together at the start of a chemical reaction.
The new substances formed during a chemical reaction.
The principle that no atoms are created or destroyed in a chemical reaction — the total mass of reactants equals the total mass of products.
